At 7 p.m. on the 11-6-38, a telephone message was
received from C.P.C. 1300 on duty at Wusong and
Hankow roads (Traffic) to the effect that a shooting
affray has just taken place. Accordingly, Sgts. 4137
C.D.C. 75 and D.C. Bremner attended and ascertained
the following:-

That at about 6.55 p.m. 11-6-38 the victim one
named Yu Ta Yoong (余大雄), 46, native of Anhwei,
married, resident of No. 412 House 18 Yates Road,
whilst alighting from his private M/car, T. & C. Lic.
No. 4699 (driver by one named Wei Shan, (Lic.) Permit
No. 4514 Victoria Chauffeur) outside the front entrance
to 704 Nanking Road, situated on the North side of Nanking
Road, 50 yards East of Tsangpo Road, was fired upon by
an unknown male Chinese only description available as
follows:- Age about 27, ht. 5'4", sallow round face,
medium build, long hair, wearing white silk jacket and
black silk pants, who was armed with a small black
pistol. Only one shot being fired, the victim was
struck a grazing blow on the left knee cap, when he
hurried into the entrance of the aforementioned premise
and in so doing fell and struck his nose, whilst his
assailant, made good his escape.

Escorted to the Lester Chinese Hospital, Dr's
chit reads "Bruise of nose and left knee--Two days'
treatment."

C.P.C. 1300 when questioned was unable to assist
in anyway, he having witnessed nothing, other than
hearing the report of the pistol shot.

until December 31st, 1937, the proprietor and

The following is the statement of Nya Ziang Sung, 36, M/chauffeur, Loh Ka Road.
native of Shanghai. taken by me Self.
at Louza Stn. on the 11-6-38. and interpreted by

I have been employed by my master Yu Ta Yoon, as a chauffeur
for about 4 months. This employment was introduced by a former
employer Lee Kuo Chi, whom I had been employed by for more than
10 years.

At a.m. 11-6-38, I parked M/car Lic. No. 4699 at outside the
Kyeu Foh Li, Mandalay Road.

At 3 p.m. even date, I drove my master to the Asia Hotel,
North Szechuen Road and put up his car on Tienlong Road.

At about 6.30 p.m. same date, I followed my master's
instructions and drove him to the Yeu Dah Tea Store at 704
Hankow Road. We arrived there at about 6.45 p.m.

Upon our arrival, my master immediately alighted. As soon
as he walked on the pavement, I heard someone fire a shot.

Owing to the fact, that there were a number of other cars
parked alongside the pavement, obstructing my sight, so I could
not see the gunman.

As soon as my master heard the shot, he ran into the
premises, 704 Hankow Road.

I have often parked the car at the Sin Yuen Tsung, Singa
Road or Kyeu Foh Li, Mandalay Road, when I was waiting for my
master, but I have not even been approached by anyone, who would
ask for my master's activities.

The above is my true statement.

Signed.

以下为余大荣（Yu Ta Yoon）的司机，宋亚祥（Nya Ziang Sung），36岁，上海籍，住址罗家路（Loh Ka Road）。由本人于1938年6月11日在老闸捕房录取，并由......翻译。

我受雇于主人余大荣担任司机约4个月。这份工作是由我的前雇主李国治（Lee Kuo Chi）介绍的，我曾为他工作超过10年。

1938年6月11日上午，我将车牌号为 4699 的汽车停在曼德勒路（Mandalay Road）久福里（Kyeu Foh Li）外。

当日下午3时，我驾车送主人至北四川路的亚洲饭店，并将车停在天潼路（Tienlong Road）。

同日下午约6时30分，我遵照主人的指示，驾车送他至汉口路704号的叶大茶庄（Yeu Dah Tea Store）。我们于下午约6时45分到达那里。

抵达后，主人立即下车。当他刚走上人行道时，我听到有人开了一枪。

由于路边停放着多辆其他汽车，遮挡了我的视线，因此我未能看到枪手。

主人听到枪声后，立即跑进汉口路704号的屋内。

我在等候主人时，经常将车停在星加路（Singa Road）的新元宗（Sin Yuen Tsung）或曼德勒路的久福里，但从未有人接近我询问主人的行踪。

以上是我的真实供词。

签名。

At 7 p.m. on 11-6-38, after pulling my master to the Kyeu
Dah Tea Store on Hankow Road, I sat on the ricksha and intended
to have a rest.
At the same moment, I observed a M/car arrive and stop
outside of the Kyeu Dah Tea Store, a man alighted from the car,
who was followed by a male Chinese, age about 50, medium build,
white round face, long hair brushed back, wearing white silk
jacket and black silk pants, who fired one shot at the former.
The man ran into the tea store and the gunman also followed him,
but left same immediately. He did not fire a 2nd shot.
The gunman also carried a thermos flask in his hand. He
decamped in a westerly direction along Hankow Road.
Later, I was called to the station and made the above
statement.

at 10 a.m. on the morning of the 21-6-38. They being the only persons arrested, of any consequence, with the assistance of the Settlement Police for armed robbery committed within the Concession limits.

All the above described accused have been charged by the French Police on three charges of armed robbery committed of recent date. They, however, could not be connected with any offences of a like nature in the Settlement. But rigid interrogation of each of the accused, during the limited period of time at the disposal of the investigating detectives, resulted in the 1st described accused, Wong Ah Mao (王阿毛), eventually admitting that he was the person who had attempted to assassinate the complainant, Yu Ta Yoong (余大荣) herein concerned, at about 6.55 p.m. on the night of the 11-6-38 outside No.704 Hankow Road.

根据安排，法国警察暂时将四名被告移交给本局人员，其详情如下：-

1. 王阿毛（Wong Ah Mao），又名王小狗子（Wong Siau Keu Ts），又名王阿民（Wong Ah Ming），26岁，山东人，职业/无业，非上海籍外国人（N.F.A.）。
2. 王玉海（Wong Nyue Hai），21岁，山东人，职业/无业，非上海籍外国人（N.F.A.）。
3. 李连荣（Li Li Yoong），26岁，北平人，职业/无业，非上海籍外国人（N.F.A.）。
4. 张玉春（Tsang Nyoh Tsung），24岁，高邮（Kompo）人，职业/无业，非上海籍外国人（N.F.A.）。

于1938年6月21日上午10时移交。他们是协助租界警察侦破在租界范围内发生的持械抢劫案中逮捕的唯一重要嫌疑人。

上述所有被告均被法国警察以近期发生的三起持械抢劫罪起诉。然而，他们与租界内任何类似性质的罪行均无关联。但是，在对每名被告进行的严格审讯中，尽管负责调查的探员时间有限，第一名被告王阿毛最终承认，他就是于1938年6月11日晚约6时55分在汉口路704号外企图刺杀本案原告余大荣（Yu Ta Yoong）的人。

（左侧手写批注：）
J. Logan 医生
C.O.C.

调查
6月26日

His reasonsfor this attempted assasination are
conflicting. He submitted in the first instance a state-
ment (attached herewith), the import of which implies
that he is a member of a certain Guerilla Unit, with
headquarters at Siking. As an active member of that
Unit he had attempted to assassinate the complainant, Yu
Ta Yoong (余大雄), whom he knew to be a traitor.

D.S.I. Ko Yen Kung and D.S.I. Logan, Special Branch,
attended and the statement (attached) taken by them from
him, implies that he had been hired by one named Ling Ah
Mau (林阿毛), who serves as a chauffeur for the Pacifica-
tion Section, Japanese Military, Pootung, to kill the
complainant Yu Ta Yoong for a reward of $500.00. Having
planned and made arrangements to do so in Room No. 405
of the Great Shanghai Hotel, No. 341 Avenue Edward VII,
French Concession. The sole purpose is said to be that
the complainant Yu Ta Yoong had been responsible for
privately detaining two boat loads of rice in Pootung,
which he presumably converted to his own use.

The present whereabouts of Ling Ah Mao are at present
unknown, but it is surmised that he is now in Pootung,
and presumably still in the employ of the Pacification
Section, there.

However, the primary object in having the above four
described accused temporarily handed over to this station

他对于此次刺杀未遂的理由前后矛盾。他最初提交了一份供词（附后），其大意暗示他是某游击队的一员，总部设在西京（Siking，音译）。作为该队的活跃成员，他试图刺杀原告余大雄（Yu Ta Yoong），因为他知道余是汉奸。

特别处探员柯燕根（Ko Yen Kung）和洛根（Logan）到场，由他们从他那里录取的供词（附后）暗示，他是受一名名为林阿毛（Ling Ah Mau）的人雇佣，此人在浦东日军宣抚班担任司机，以500美元酬金杀害原告余大荣。策划和安排此事的地点是在法租界爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）341号大华饭店（Great Shanghai Hotel）405室。据称，唯一的原因是原告余大荣曾在浦东私自扣留两船大米，并据为己有。

林阿毛目前的下落不明，但推测他现在浦东，可能仍受雇于那里的宣抚班。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
A
The following is the statement of Wong Ah Mau
native of Fiantan taken by me
at Louza Stn. on the 24-6-38 and interpreted by Clark Chan.

I was formerly employed as a coolie in the Kiangnan Dock
江南造船廠 in Shanghai. When the Sino-Japanese trouble broke out
I joined the National Peace Preservation Corps in Nantao. Later
I retreated with the Chinese Army to Kunshan (崑山) where we
scattered and I returned to Shanghai again.
In October last year I joined a Chinese Mobile
Unit in Sze-yang (泗泾), and joined them.
Ts Pao Lin 朱宝林 was my Superior and my monthly wage was
$10.00. On 11th June 1938 my Superior on returning
from Shanghai after making enquiries told me that
one named Yac Doh Yuen (余大雄) was a big traitor working under
the Japanese and sold information about boats in Soochow
Creek and ought to be killed. On 27-6-38 my Superior and
I came to Shanghai with the intention to kill the
victim. On arrival at Shanghai we went to Aocchiao (曹橋) in
Pootung to try to locate the informer who lived in a
lodging house in French town. A man named Wang Ming (王寶民)
employed by the Tai Dao (大通) Government as a teaboy was located
who stated that the traitor who had a private car No. 4099
visited No. 704 Hankow Road daily. He visited the place four
times and saw the above mentioned motor arrive at regular times.
At 6 p.m. 11-5-38, my Superior and I went to the spot where
we waited for about half an hour and at last we saw the said
car coming and my Superior showed me the intended victim who
at that time was alighting from the car. I fired one shot at
him but gave me no chance to fire the second one as he ran into
the shop and hid himself under the counter. I escaped from the
page_data.zh:
W.RM 40
G. 30M-1-38

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。
A
以下为王阿毛（Wong Ah Mau）的供词，樊潭（Fiantan，音译）人，由本人于1938年6月24日在老闸捕房录取，并由陈克拉克（Clark Chan）翻译。

我以前在上海江南造船厂（Kiangnan Dock）做苦力。当中日冲突爆发时，我加入了南市的国家和平保全团（National Peace Preservation Corps）。后来随中国军队撤退至昆山，队伍解散后我又回到上海。
去年十月，我加入了泗泾（Sze-yang）的一支中国流动部队，并加入其中。
朱宝林（Ts Pao Lin）是我的上级，我的月薪是10.00美元。1938年6月11日，我的上级从上海调查回来后告诉我，一个叫余大雄（Yac Doh Yuen）的人是大汉奸，为日本人工作，出卖苏州河船只的情报，应该被杀掉。1938年6月27日，我的上级和我来到上海，意图杀死受害者。到达上海后，我们去了浦东曹桥（Aocchiao），试图寻找住在法租界旅馆里的线人。我们找到了一个叫王宝民（Wang Ming）的人，他在大通（Tai Dao）政府做茶房，他说那个拥有私家车（车牌号4099）的汉奸每天都去汉口路704号。他去了四次，看到上述汽车按时到达。
1938年5月11日下午6时，我的上级和我去了现场，我们等了大约半小时，最后看到那辆车来了，我的上级向我指出了预定的受害者，当时他正从车上下来。我向他开了一枪，但他跑进店里躲在柜台下，没给我开第二枪的机会。我从

page_data.en:
Wong Ah Mao (王阿毛).
B
Tientsin
D.S.I. Logan (Sp. Br.)
Louza Stn. June 21, 1938.
D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken.

Wong Ah-mao, alias Wong Siao Kur-ts (王小格仔), alias
Wong Ah-ming (王阿民), aged 26, a native of Tientsin,
and single. I reside in an unnumbered straw hut at Shih
Pah Kan (十八间), Peotung. (opposite Yangtszepoo). I
am a shipwright by profession, but for the past four months
have served as a public ricsha puller in Peotung.

Prior to the outbreak of hostilities in August, 1937,
I was employed in the Kiangnan Dock, Kaochongmiao, as a shipwright
I hold that position for about 5 years.

About a month after the outbreak of hostilities, I
joined the 4th Artillery Company, 3rd Battalion, 14th Regiment
of the Pacantui, then billeted at Shih Hwei Jao, Nantao, as an
assistant. About another month later, the unit was
transferred to Quinsan. Following the withdrawal of Chinese
troops from Quinsan, the Pacantui was disbanded, and thereupon
I served as a member of mobile unit in the suburbs of Quinsan.
About four and a half months ago, I fled to Shanghai as a refugee.
After staying in the 4th Refugee Camp of the International
Relief Committee, Ferry Road near Macao Road, where I gave my
name as Wong Ah-ming (王阿民), for about a fortnight, I went
to live in a hut at Shih Pah Kan, Peetung, (present address) and
began to earn my living by serving as a public ricsha puller.

At about 7 p.m. June 10, a former neighbour of mine
named Ling Ah-pao (林阿宝), aged about 27 and a native of
Peetung, who at present serves as a chauffeur for the Pacification
Section (宣撫班) of the Japanese Military, came to my house
page_data.zh:
王阿毛（Wong Ah Mao）。
B
天津
特别处洛根（Logan）探员
老闸捕房 1938年6月21日。
高燕根（Kao Yen-ken）探员。

王阿毛，又名王小格仔（Wong Siao Kur-ts），又名王阿民（Wong Ah-ming），26岁，天津人，未婚。我居住在浦东十八间（Shih Pah Kan）的一间无门牌号的草棚里。（对面是杨树浦）。我的职业是造船工人，但在过去四个月里，我在浦东做公共黄包车夫。

在1937年8月战事爆发之前，我在高桥庙（Kaochongmiao）的江南造船厂做造船工人。
我担任该职位约5年。

战事爆发约一个月后，我作为助手加入了驻扎在南市石汇角（Shih Hwei Jao）的“保安团”（Pacantui，音译）第14团第3营第4炮兵连。大约又过了一个月，该部队调往昆山。随着中国军队从昆山撤退，“保安团”解散，随后我在昆山郊区的一支流动部队中服役。大约四个半月前，我作为难民逃到上海。
在国际救济委员会第四难民营（位于澳门路附近的斐伦路/Ferry Road）住了约两周后，我报姓名为王阿民（Wong Ah-ming），之后我去浦东十八间（现住址）的一间棚屋居住，并开始靠做公共黄包车夫谋生。

6月10日晚7时许，我的一位前邻居，名叫林阿宝（Ling Ah-pao），约27岁，浦东人，目前在日军宣抚班（Pacification Section）担任司机，来到我家

page_data.en:
-2-
with another unknown Chinese. He told me that should I dare
to kill one official of the Dah Dao City Government named Yu
Ta Yoong (余大庸), he would give me a reward of $500.00. He
also informed me that some time ago, Yu Ta Yoong privately
detained two rice boats at a certain place and that the
distribution of the booty was not satisfactory to him. I
agreed to the suggestion. Thereupon Ling Ah Pao produced
a pistol from his pocket and taught me how to fire it.
At about 8 a.m. the same day, Ling and I came to Shanghai,
landing at the French Bund. On the way, Ling carried the
pistol. On arrival, we walked to Hankow Road, where he pointed
out to me a tea shop which had not at that time opened for
business and which is situated next to the Dah Jen Tang (大仁堂)
Medicine Shop. He also pointed out a motor car No. 4699,
grey in colour, and stated that it belonged to Yu Ta Yoong.
He also mentioned that Yu Ta Yoong wore spectacles. After
making observation for about half an hour, we went to the
Great Shanghai Hotel, 341 Avenue Edward VII, French Concession,
corner of Rue Rue, and booked a room No. 408, in which we passed
the night. Ling left the hotel at about 5 a.m. on June 11
and came back at about 5.30 p.m. Throughout that period,
I remained in the room of the said hotel. At 6 p.m.
June 11 we left the hotel and proceeded to the above described
place on Hankow Road on foot. We waited there until about
7 p.m., when we saw motor car no. 4699 approaching from the west
along Hankow Road. The car stopped at the point described
above and Yu Ta Yoong alighted. At that time I was standing
page_data.zh:
-2-
与另一名身份不明的中国人在一起。他告诉我，如果我敢杀害一名名为余大庸（Yu Ta Yoong）的大道市政府官员，他将给我500.00美元的酬金。他还告知我，不久前，余大庸在某地私自扣押了两艘运米船，而赃物的分配令他不满。我同意了他的提议。随后，凌阿宝（Ling Ah Pao）从口袋里掏出一把手枪，并教我如何射击。
当天上午8点左右，凌和我来到上海，在法外滩登陆。途中，手枪由凌携带。抵达后，我们步行至汉口路，他指给我看一家当时尚未营业的茶馆，该茶馆位于大仁堂（Dah Jen Tang）药店旁边。他还指着一辆灰色的4699号汽车，称该车属于余大庸。他还提到余大庸戴眼镜。观察了约半小时后，我们前往法租界爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）341号、吕班路（Rue Rue）转角的大上海大酒店（Great Shanghai Hotel），预订了408号房间，并在那里过夜。6月11日凌晨5点左右，凌离开酒店，并于下午5点30分左右返回。在此期间，我一直待在该酒店的房间里。6月11日下午6点，我们离开酒店，步行前往上述汉口路的地点。我们在那里等到晚上7点左右，这时我们看到4699号汽车沿汉口路从西面驶来。汽车在上述地点停下，余大庸下车。当时我正站在

page_data.en:
...the Hang Jen Tang Medicine Shop next to
...belonging to Yu Ta Yeeng. On seeing Yu entering
..., I fired one shot and thereafter made good my
..., going back direct to the Great Shanghai Hotel, Room 405.
...I met Ling in the hotel. He asked me whether Yu Ta-yeeng
had been killed. I told him in the negative. He soon left
the room, saying that he would come again and discuss the matter
on the next morning. Since that time, I have not seen Ling
and have not received any money for the undertaking.

Ling Ah-pao was formerly a chauffeur in the employ of
the Yellow Taxi Company (now closed). He is now attached
to the Chenju Office of the Pacification Section of the Japanese
Military. Every day he comes to the Peotung Office of the
Pacification Section and makes reports of his trips during the
previous day. He sleeps in the quarters of the Pacification
Section on Tung Cheng Road, Peotung.
page_data.zh:
……大仁堂药店旁边的……
……属于余大庸（Yu Ta Yeeng）。看到余进入
……，我开了一枪，随后成功逃离
……，直接返回大上海大酒店405号房间。
……我在酒店遇到了凌。他问我余大庸（Yu Ta-yeeng）是否已被杀死。我予以否认。他很快离开了房间，说第二天会再来商议此事。自那以后，我再未见过凌，也未收到任何关于此项行动的酬金。

凌阿宝（Ling Ah-pao）曾是黄包车出租车公司（Yellow Taxi Company，现已停业）的司机。他目前隶属于日本军方绥靖部门陈居办公室（Chenju Office）。他每天前往浦东绥靖部门办公室，汇报前一天的行程。他住在浦东东昌路（Tung Cheng Road）绥靖部门的宿舍里。

THE ASSASSINATION OF YU TA-YUNG 


Yu Ta-yung (Art 6), a high officiel of the 
“Reformed Government", who was assassinated in the morning 
of October 17 at tha New Asia Hotel, which is under the 
protection of the Japanese, was formally encoffined at 
noon yesterday at the hotel. According tc a certain 
person who witnessed the encoffining, the deceased borein 
all six axe-woundas one on the bridge of his nose, one on 
the left cheek, one on the right temple, one of the lower 
chin, one on the right hand and one on the chest which 
hed cut open the stomach. His right arm bore deep marks 
of teeth, which had apparently been caused by the assassins 
when he resisted. His tragic death in the New Asia 
Hotel where strict precautionary measures are in force has 
caused much exoitement among all officials who are at 
present living in the hotel. 

The eye-witnesa further stated thet as soon as 
the enooffining was completed, it was taken to Kiangwan 
for burial in a certain public cemetery. It ie said that 
representatives of the “Reformed Government" an th 
puppet organizations as well as of Fu Siao-en ({8m )» 
the new Mayor of the Shanghai Speoial Municipal Government, 
attended the funeral. 

The deceased was 52 years of aze and is 
survived by a wife, a conoubine and four sons, the eldest 
of whom is at present in the employ of the Ministry of 
Interior of the “Reformed Government". 


Acoording to information secured by a reporter

examination of the seized pistol by the Arms Identification 
: Section, SeM.P., it was identified as the pistol which had been 
“ ed in the attempted assassimtion of Yu Ta Yoong. 
Wong Ahemao was temporarily handed over to the
